description: Cycles through every Relay CLI feature hourly, posting a Slack check asking the team to confirm whether the feature works as intended. Tracks progress across the full manifest and resets after a complete cycle.

SLACK_CHANNEL.description: Slack channel to post feature checks to (e.g. relay-health or general).

SLACK_USER_WILL.description: Slack user ID for Will (e.g. U01234ABCDE). Used for @mentions in checks.

SLACK_USER_KHALIQ.description: Slack user ID for Khaliq (e.g. U01234ABCDE). Used for @mentions in checks.
